text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Shuka Sho, and the massive crowd gathered at Kyoto Racecourse has their attention on Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Fine Motion! Do your best out there!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There are so many people cheering me on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The weight of all those expectations might be enough to crush someone else, but…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: After all, the fact they're looking is precisely what gives shape to me as "Fine Motion."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her mental fortitude has always turned those expectations into strength. I assume she won't have any problems today either. However…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hurry after her and find her standing alone. By the look on her face, she seems to be holding something back.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, I think so. I mean…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Look, I just can't keep this grin off my face!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Argh! Compose yourself, Fine! You must smile elegantly when in front of everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If I keep this up, Shakur is going to call me a grinning fool or something!
choice_data_list: Uhhh, so what exactly are you worried about?
Uhhh, so what exactly are you worried about?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That I'll disappoint the audience, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to this race so much I'm liable to run with gleeful abandon. I'll be just like Wild!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wild is a dog I used to have. He was very naughty, so we called him "Wild"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm sure all the spectators are hoping to see me run elegantly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I need to keep my feelings in check or I'll be bounding around like Wild…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm. Does that make me a bit strange?
choice_data_list: You're not worried about the race itself?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Not at all! I'm very much looking forward to it.
choice_data_list: Then you should run however you want.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But if I look different than how everyone expects—
choice_data_list: It's fine. You're already showing them what they want to see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pardon?!
choice_data_list: All everyone wants to see is you enjoying yourself.
All everyone wants to see is you enjoying yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …It is?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: The way Fine Motion runs is… Well, it's pretty impressive, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Fine Motion! You were wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everywhere Fine Motion goes, she captures the hearts of spectators and helps people find their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Their dreams…

text_block_list.name: Formerly Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text: But I was drawn in by how you ran, and I started to enjoy it myself. I'm going to do my best to feel that way again!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …I see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I thought I was the only one getting anything… but I can give something to others when I run as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've got it! Then, I'm going to have as much fun as I can today!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run as hard as I can, and experience that wonderful view with everyone!
